collection.name: CENSORED
collection.openText: Do not attempt to understand it.

specialTipSize.specialTip: When an employee enters $0’s Containment Unit, lower-level employees panic immediately.
At the end of work, an employee with empty SP decreases $0’s Qliphoth Counter.
A Bad work result decreases $0’s Qliphoth Counter again.
When $0’s Qliphoth Counter reaches zero, it breaches containment.
After breaching, $0 attacks employees; each child independently searches for and attacks employees.
While processing a tombstone, $0 temporarily cannot take damage and creates a child when the process ends.
